camel_example: aliyun hbr CreateHanaRestore --region cn-hangzhou --ClusterId 'cl-000fbrs5000000ka9w' --BackupPrefix COMPLETE_DATA_BACKUP_2022_05_02_15_39 --Mode RECOVERY_TO_POINT_IN_TIME --DatabaseName TS2
description_en: Creates a restore job for an SAP HANA database
description_zh: 创建SAP HANA数据库恢复任务
kebab_example: aliyun hbr create-hana-restore --cluster-id cl-000fbrs5000000ka9w --database-name TS2 --biz-mode RECOVERY_TO_POINT_IN_TIME --backup-prefix COMPLETE_DATA_BACKUP_2022_05_02_15_39 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateHanaRestore

parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup vault
parameters.name: vault_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SAP HANA instance that you want to restore
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the database that you want to restore
parameters.name: database_name

parameters.help_en:
The recovery mode. Valid values:

RECOVERY_TO_MOST_RECENT: restores the database to the recently available state to which the database has been backed up.
RECOVERY_TO_POINT_IN_TIME: restores the database to a specified point in time.
RECOVERY_TO_SPECIFIC_BACKUP: restores the database to a specified backup.
RECOVERY_TO_LOG_POSITION: restores the database to a specified log position
parameters.help_zh:
恢复方式。
RECOVERY_TO_MOST_RECENT： 最近时间，将数据库恢复到已备份的最近可用状态。
RECOVERY_TO_POINT_IN_TIME：指定时间，将数据库恢复到特定时间点。
RECOVERY_TO_SPECIFIC_BACKUP：指定备份，将数据库恢复到指定的数据库备份。
RECOVERY_TO_LOG_POSITION：日志位置，将数据库还原到指定日志位置
parameters.name: mode

parameters.help_en: The point in time to which you want to restore the database. This parameter is valid only if you set the Mode parameter to RECOVERY_TO_POINT_IN_TIME. HBR restores the database to a state closest to the specified point in time
parameters.help_zh: 选择需要恢复到的时间点。仅选择RECOVERY_TO_POINT_IN_TIME恢复方式时有效，系统会将数据库恢复到离这个时间最近的状态
parameters.name: recovery_point_in_time

parameters.help_en: The log position to which you want to restore the database. This parameter is valid only if you set the Mode parameter to RECOVERY_TO_LOG_POSITION
parameters.help_zh: 日志位置，仅选择RECOVERY_TO_LOG_POSITION恢复方式时有效
parameters.name: log_position

parameters.help_en: The ID of the volume that you want to restore. This parameter is valid only if you set the Mode parameter to RECOVERY_TO_LOG_POSITION
parameters.help_zh: 要恢复的Volume ID。仅选择RECOVERY_TO_LOG_POSITION恢复方式时有效
parameters.name: volume_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to use a catalog backup to restore the database. This parameter is required only if you set the Mode parameter to RECOVERY_TO_SPECIFIC_BACKUP. If you turn off Use Catalog, you must specify the prefix of a backup file. Then, Cloud Backup finds the backup file based on the specified prefix and restores the backup file
parameters.help_zh: 是否从Catalog中查找备份。仅选择RECOVERY_TO_SPECIFIC_BACKUP恢复方式时有效。如果不使用Catalog，需要指定一个备份前缀，云备份服务会根据备份前缀进行恢复
parameters.name: use_catalog

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to restore the database to a different instance
parameters.name: system_copy

parameters.help_en: The name of the source system. This parameter specifies the name of the source database that you want to restore. You must set the parameter in the `<Source database name>@SID` format
parameters.help_zh: 源系统名。表示需要恢复的源数据库名，格式为`源数据库名@SID`
parameters.name: source

parameters.help_en: The ID of the source SAP HANA instance
parameters.name: source_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to delete all log entries from the log area after the log entries are restored. Valid values: true and false. If you set the value to false, all log entries are deleted from the log area after the log entries are restored
parameters.help_zh: 初始化日志区域，如果不想恢复驻留在日志区中的日志段，请选择false。恢复后, 日志条目将从日志区中删除
parameters.name: clear_log

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to validate the differential backup and log backup. Valid values: true and false. If you set the value to true, HBR checks whether the required differential backup and log backup are available before the restore job starts. If the differential backup or log backup is unavailable, HBR does not start the restore job
parameters.help_zh: 检查差异和日志备份可用性。开启此项后，在恢复开始时，系统会检查所需的差异备份和日志备份是否都可用。 如果缺少差异备份或日志备份，在更改数据之前会停止恢复
parameters.name: check_access

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to use a differential backup or an incremental backup to restore the database. Valid values: true and false. If you want to use a differential backup or an incremental backup to restore the database, set the value to true. If you set the value to false, HBR uses a log backup to restore the database
parameters.help_zh: 使用差异备份。如果您需要使用差异备份或增量备份执行恢复，请选择此选项。如果选择在不使用差异备份或增量备份的情况下执行恢复，则使用日志备份进行恢复
parameters.name: use_delta

parameters.help_en: The SID admin account that is created by SAP HANA
parameters.help_zh: SidAdmin，SAP HANA创建的一个系统账号
parameters.name: sid_admin

parameters.help_en: The ID of the client where the primary node of the SAP HANA resides
parameters.name: master_client_id

Code.description_en: The HTTP status code. The status code 200 indicates that the call is successful

Message.description_en: The message that is returned. If the call is successful, "successful" is returned. If the call fails, an error message is returned
Message.description_zh: 返回信息描述，成功一般返回successful，错误时会返回相应错误信息

RestoreId.description_en: The ID of the restore job

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful. Valid values:

true: The call is successful.
false: The call fails
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。

true：成功
false：失败
